_help: The News Hunter's search list: key people and official pages of the Northeast states. Each account says where it was found (source). 'found' = found in an official or news source; 'check' = found only on a third-party or search-snippet source, confirm on the platform before relying on it. Nothing here is used to publish anything: it only opens profiles for you to read. Last researched 2026-10-30.
